name: Rooted Delusion
effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **^^Strike-last^^**. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.
declare: Pick a friendly **^^Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
